Aucune parole donnée au Phénix: No word given to the Phoenix

Une porte de pierre, couverte de signes: A stone door, covered in ancient signs. A riddle is carved on it; the Phoenix texts give its answer to whoever takes the time to read them.
Ou il y a un levier de bronze derrière l: Or there’s a bronze lever behind the stone, within reach of a blade. The mechanism would give way in one blow.
Le temps, c’est ce qui nous manque. Bris: Time is the one thing we lack. Let’s break it.
Seek the answer in the texts.

Une oasis tenue par les érudits du Scorp: An oasis kept by the Scorpion scholars. The water is cool, and no one asks anything of us. Not yet.
Ici, même l’eau a un prix. On nous le di: Here, even water has a price. We’ll be told it later.

Ou un bon coup de marteau. Un sceau bris: Or a good blow of the hammer. A broken seal doesn’t burn anyone any more.
Que faisons-nous de ces sceaux ?: What do we do with these seals?
La route ouverte selon le rite du Phénix: The road opened by the Phoenix rite

Une bibliothèque du Phénix, à moitié ens: A Phoenix library, half buried. The sand has kept its scrolls better than any guardian.

Que faisons-nous de cette bibliothèque ?: What do we do with this library?
La bibliothèque laissée au Phénix: The library left to the Phoenix
Je recouvre l’entrée de sable. Elle a at: I cover the entrance with sand again. It has waited for centuries; it will wait a while longer.
Un érudit du Scorpion campait près des r: A Scorpion scholar was camped near the ruins. He paid for the scrolls without haggling, and without asking where they came from.
Le Scorpion lit tout et ne comprend rien: The Scorpion reads everything and understands nothing. This codex will not leave its flame while I draw breath.
Le codex. Ses pages sont chaudes, comme: The codex. Its pages are warm, as if the flame had read them before us. Let us bring it back to the Grand Inquisitor.

Ni pour le Scorpion, ni pour le Phénix :: Not for the Scorpion, not for the Phoenix: for yourselves alone. You are no better than those who send you.
Le codex est à nous. Le Scorpion et le P: The codex is ours. The Scorpion and the Phoenix will have to deal with whoever holds it.
Ou ils s’uniront pour le reprendre, et n: Or they will unite to take it back, and we will have no right to complain.

Les flammes purificatrices du Phénix nai: The Phoenix’s purifying flames are born here. This place is not ours.
Des braises qui ne s’éteignent jamais. U: Embers that never go out. A smith would give a fortune for them, and a scholar more.

Maelor emporte une braise, rouge comme u: Maelor takes an ember, red as a gem. Behind us, the ashes grow pale.
Les prophéties… ne sont que des mots. Ce: Prophecies… are only words. Those I serve need nothing but words, and a clan ready to believe them.
The Shadows, behind a fourth clan. The Phoenix did not choose its hatred of the Scorpion alone: it was whispered to it.
Le Sceau est à vous. Mes érudits l’ont c: The Seal is yours. My scholars have recorded it. Do not count on the Scorpion’s knowledge any longer, on the day you need it.
Vous n’êtes pas des leurs ? Alors écoute: You are not one of them? Then listen: at the temple, a stranger has been speaking to our guardians for moons. He prophesies, and they listen to him.
Le Grand Inquisiteur saura qui nous a pr: The Grand Inquisitor will know who took our witness from us.
Un camp d’érudits du Scorpion sur la pis: A camp of Scorpion scholars on the temple track. They’ve tied a Phoenix faithful at the foot of a tent, and they’ve been questioning him since dawn.
Il connaît les passages du temple. Il fi: He knows the temple’s passages. In the end he will tell them. The Grand Inquisitor has given us as much time as it takes.
Je ne dirai rien du temple. Faites de mo: I will say nothing of the temple. Do with me what you will.
Laissons les érudits travailler. Ce qu’i: Let the scholars work. What he says will serve us as much as them, and the Scorpion will know we’re not in its way.
Ils le privent d’eau depuis l’aube. Il n: They have kept water from him since dawn. He will not last until evening.
Un acte que le Scorpion consignera: A deed the Scorpion will record

Prenez ceci pour la route. Le Scorpion s: Take this for the road. The Scorpion knows how to thank those who stay out of its way.

On dit que Kaelen vous a confié le Sceau: It is said that Kaelen entrusted you with the Seal of the Dragon, and that a Shadow Shaman fell on its peaks. The Dragon is rarely wrong. I will see for myself.
Mes érudits ont aussi noté le Sceau du D: My scholars have also noted the Seal of the Dragon, wrested from Kaelen by trial. I do not judge yet. I note.
Trois Sceaux vous ont menés jusqu’ici. C: Three Seals have brought you this far. What they are worth, my scholars will record.

Nos archives gardent aussi la chute de v: Our archives also keep the fall of your clan. Your allies all turned against you, on the strength of the same rumours. The Scorpion never believed in that coincidence.
Les archives gardent ce qu’on leur racon: Archives keep whatever they are told, Grand Inquisitor. Let us speak of the codex instead.
Le Phénix est trop idéaliste pour compre: The Phoenix is too idealistic to understand what it guards. It prays before its purifying flames and lets the one text that could arm us lie dormant. Bring me this codex, and the Seal of the Scorpion will hear your name.
Un savoir interdit l’est rarement sans r: Forbidden knowledge is rarely forbidden without reason, Grand Inquisitor. And a text read by a single clan says only what that clan wants to read in it. Let us seek the truth for ourselves before entrusting it to anyone.
Or let us read this codex before anyone else. Knowledge that every clan covets is worth more than any Seal, to whoever knows whom to sell it to… I only say what everyone thinks before such a bargain.
Nous sommes venus chercher un Sceau, pas: We came for a Seal, not for knowledge to sell on.
Alors. Me rapporterez-vous le codex prop: Well, then. Will you bring me the prophetic codex?
Bring back the codex without bargaining.
Parole claire devant le Scorpion: A clear word before the Scorpion
Le Grand Inquisiteur observe votre condu: The Grand Inquisitor watches your conduct
Demand to read the codex before he does.
Le codex lu avant lui: The codex read ahead of him
L’exigence pèsera dans le jugement: The demand will weigh in the judgement

Vous voulez lire avant moi ce que je che: You want to read before me what I have sought for years. So be it. My scholars will note this demand as well.

Ou gardons-le. Le seul texte qui parle d: Or let’s keep it. The only text that speaks of the Shadows, in our hands: the Scorpion will have to deal with us, and so will the Phoenix.
Prendre le codex pour le Grand Inquisite: Take the codex for the Grand Inquisitor.

Le codex rapporté au Scorpion: The codex brought back to the Scorpion

Celui qui écrivait ici est parti avant n: Whoever wrote here left before we came. He knew someone would come looking for him.
Comme les pèlerins du Dragon, ils veulen: Like the Dragon pilgrims, they want to speak in their own words. Let them walk with us.
Les pèlerins du Dragon se sont tus sous: The Dragon pilgrims fell silent under our blades. I do not want the desert to count any more.
Nous avons quitté le temple derrière vou: We left the temple in your wake. What we have seen there for moons, someone must hear: the stranger who whispered to our guardians prophecies no one had ever read.
Nous avons fui le temple pendant le comb: We fled the temple during the battle. We saw everything: the codex, the flame, and the stranger who whispered to our guardians prophecies no one had ever read.
Ils ont vu ce que nous avons fait du cod: They saw what we did with the codex. If they speak to the Grand Inquisitor, we won’t have anything left to explain.
Des fidèles du Phénix devant le Grand In: Phoenix faithful before the Grand Inquisitor… He’ll listen to them, then he’ll keep them. The Scorpion never lets a witness go.

Escorter les fidèles jusqu’au Grand Inqu: Escort the faithful to the Grand Inquisitor.

Quelqu’un a écrit entre les lignes du co: Someone has written between the lines of the codex. Not a prophecy: an order, slipped into the faith of others.
Une page que personne ne devrait lire. B: A page no one should read. Let’s burn it, and say no more about it.
Que faisons-nous de cette page ?: What do we do with this page?
Une preuve à montrer au Grand Inquisiteu: Evidence to show the Grand Inquisitor
